title: A Day at the Playground
text:
It is a sunny day in spring. Lucy goes to the playground with her dog, Max. There are swings, a slide, and a big tree.

Lucy likes the playground in spring because the flowers are pretty. In summer it is very hot, and in winter it is very cold. Lucy plays outside in spring and in summer.

questions.text: What does Lucy take to the playground?
Why does Lucy like the playground in spring?
options: Because she has a new bike

questions.text: Why might Lucy not go to the playground in winter?
options: Because it is too cold outside
Because the playground is closed forever
Because she does not like her dog

questions.text: How does Lucy probably feel at the playground?

vocabulary.definition: a park area with equipment for children to play on
seats hung from ropes that move back and forth
the colorful parts of a plant
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: İlkbaharda güneşli bir gün. Lucy köpeği Max ile oyun alanına gider. Orada salıncaklar, bir kaydırak ve büyük bir ağaç vardır.
Lucy ilkbaharda oyun alanını sever çünkü çiçekler güzeldir. Yazın hava çok sıcaktır ve kışın hava çok soğuktur. Lucy ilkbahar ve yazda dışarıda oynar.
